description: Search brands (manufacturers) registered on authorized.by, or list them all. Read-only. Returns for each brand: id, name, slug, logo and the number of retailers it has authorized. Omit 'search' to retrieve the full index; use 'page' and 'size' to paginate. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

search.description: Filter by brand name or alias. Optional.

name: get_brands

outputSchema.description: A page of brands plus network-wide totals and pagination.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

retailer_count.description: Number of retailers currently authorized by this brand on authorized.by.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

total_brands.description: Total number of public brands on authorized.by.

total_connections.description: Total number of active brand-retailer authorizations on authorized.by.

total_retailers.description: Total number of public retailers on authorized.by.

page.description: Zero-based page number of this response.

size.description: Page size used for this response.

total_items.description: Total number of matching entries across all pages.

title: Search brands
